AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-22-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Goitom Berih Uwal was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Miraf Sinai Berih, who was also present at today's hearing.
The minor's mother, Nighisti Beyene Ghebrealfa, was present and placed under oath.
Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Sinai Goitom Berih.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.
Petitioners, Goitom Berih Uwal and Nighisti Ghebrealfa, were present in pro per as Guardian ad litems for and with the Minor, Miraf Sinai Berih.
Proof of Publication in file.

Publication of proposed name change does not match new name proposed by petitioners. Good cause appearing, matter is continued to May 22, 2008 @ 9:00 a.m. for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.

Petitioners advised to seek further guidance at the Access Center.
